Pendidikan dan Pertumbuhan Ekonomi
Abstrak
Penelitian ini mengkaji pendidikan dan pertumbuhan ekonomi.
Kami meneliti 120 peserta pada tahun 2024. Rata-rata sampel adalah 12.5.
Metode

Hasil
Pendidikan berhubungan dengan pertumbuhan ekonomi.

name: password-protected.pdf
text:
Education and Economic Growth
Abstract
This study examines education and economic growth.
We studied 120 participants in 2024. The sample mean was 12.5.
The confidence interval was 10.2 to 14.8 and p = 0.031.
Methods
The participants completed a survey.
Results
Education was associated with economic growth.
References
Smith, A. (2024). Education research. doi:10.1234/example.2024.001
